# First, filter the dataframe to only include games where the result is a win
win_games = df[df['result'] == 'win']

# Check if there are any win games where the wildcats points are greater than 7
any_win_with_more_than_7_points = (win_games['wildcats points'] > 7).any()

# The statement says "the wildcats never scored more than 7 points in any game they won"
# This is equivalent to checking if there is no win game with wildcats points > 7
# So the statement is true if there are no such games, false otherwise
statement_is_true = not any_win_with_more_than_7_points

answer = statement_is_true
